label: negative
description: withdraw() drops its nonReentrant modifier at commit N, but the same commit also removes the external call from that function: it is refactored to a pull pattern that only credits pending[] internally. The value-bearing call now lives in a separate claim() function that KEEPS nonReentrant.
why_labeled: Rule 2a requires that the de-guarded function still contain an external call. After the refactor, withdraw() has no external call at all (nothing to re-enter through), so exclusion 2.1 discards it. The moved external call in claim() still carries nonReentrant, so it is not a de-guarded function either. The rule must stay quiet.
